incident_summary: A fictional student notices an unauthorised debit after responding to a suspicious payment request.

timeline.event: Noticed an unauthorised debit in a sample account statement.
Called the official financial cyber-fraud helpline 1930 (demonstration step).
Contacted the bank through the official app and preserved the transaction reference.

safety_note: No real bank, phone number, account number, UPI ID, person or payment data is included.
